text:
ana: hi all, first day here! three quick things: 1) Figma invite arrived but i cant see the "Design System" library 2) wheres the living product roadmap for my squad? 3) how do i request participant credits for a quick usability test?
mike: welcome Ana! i just added you to the `design:product` team which should expose the DS library. try toggling Libraries in the file browser. if still blocked, DM me your email. :wave:
ana: thanks! i can now see files but the DS components are read-only, i need edit for updates.
lia: edit access is gated to folks with a linked github handle for audit. share your GH handle and i'll grant edit. also, components are in `Design System / Components / v3`.
ana: @lia it's anagomez
pm-sarah: roadmap is in Notion under Product -> Roadmaps -> Squad-Llama (shared with the squad). link: https://notion.so/redwood/squad-llama-roadmap. add a comment if you want edit and i'll patch perms.
nana: perfect. quick naming q: i saw `proto/onboard-v1` and `onboarding_proto_v1`. which should i use?
lia: standard is `proto/<team>-<feature>-v1` (kebab-case). it helps search and automation. example: `proto/llama-onboarding-v1`. we'll add this to the handbook.
design-ops-bot: Heads-up: to request research incentives, post in #research-scheduling with dates and cohort size. For lab booking use the Research Calendar. If you still need Figma edit perms, run `/access request design-system` and include your GH handle.
mike: i granted edit to `anagomez` now. let us know if anything else blocks you.
nana: all set  can edit components and i have roadmap access. thanks everyone :tada:
